extracted.name: Spinach Egg White Muffins
extracted.description: This easy mini spinach egg white muffin recipe includes light Cheddar cheese and hot sauce for a healthier take on spinach and cheese breakfast quiches.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
6 ounces shredded reduced-fat sharp Cheddar cheese, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat 10 muffin cups with cooking spray.
Combine spinach, egg whites, Cheddar cheese, hot sauce, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Ladle mixture into the prepared muffin cups, filling each cup ¾ full.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted into centers of muffins comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm or cooled.
